summary: Iteration 11 testing of project delete-cascade, project status field, and sprint filters. Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_project_delete_status.py (23 tests) — 22 pass, 1 real bug found (POST /projects does not validate status enum). Cascade delete verified end-to-end (project + sprint + task + comment + time entry + ACTIVE timer all removed, {ok:true,deleted_tasks:1}); RBAC verified for owner(200)/manager(403)/member(403)/anon(401); 404 for unknown pid; sprint filters verified for project_id, status, both, neither, unknown pid, and member-ACL ([] for inaccessible project). Full regression suite re-run serially: 173 passed / 3 failed (1 new bug + 2 pre-existing drift). Frontend: Playwright flows for admin/manager/member — status badge on project cards, edit-dialog Status select, red Delete project button with confirm + cascade toast, sprint project/status filters + Clear + empty state, plus regression of login, 5 task views, assignee filter, search, timer start/stop, comments, kanban drag, burndown, /team, /members, /analytics, workspace settings, profile. One spec miss found: the Create-project dialog has NO Status select.

minor.issue: status is NOT validated on create — {"status":"garbage"} returns 200 and persists. PATCH correctly returns 400 for the same value, so validation is asymmetric. Downstream UI damage confirmed: the project card badge renders empty with class="... rounded undefined" (STATUS_STYLES/STATUS_LABELS lookup miss) and the edit dialog Status select renders blank. Fix: reuse the same enum check in create_project, or better use Literal['planning','active','on_hold','archived'] in ProjectCreate/ProjectUpdate.

Only checks org role >= manager; it does NOT call require_project_access. A manager who is not a project member can rename/change status/color of ANY project in the org, even though the same manager gets [] from GET /projects and 403 on task routes for that project. Inconsistent with the project-ACL model used everywhere else.

Works as specified, but the new project_id/status query params are unused by the frontend (Sprints.jsx filters client-side), so this is currently dead API surface. Not a defect — just noting the duplication.
Unknown org id returns 403 instead of 404 (test_iter10 failure, unchanged).
Seeded admin's project_role on 'Web Redesign' is 'member' not 'lead' (test_project_members failure, data drift, unchanged).

Endpoint does not exist — once a user is invited to a workspace there is no way to remove them (only project-level removal exists). Left 4 throwaway test users in Acme Corp during this run; had to delete them straight from MongoDB.

ui_bugs.issue: SPEC MISS: there is no Status Select in the create dialog. data-testid="project-create-status" does not exist and the create payload ({name,key,description,color}) never sends status, so every new project silently defaults to 'active'. Requirement 'Create project dialog has a Status Select (default Active)' is NOT implemented.

Org members (role=member) can open the full Edit project dialog via the sprint card project link (sprint-project-link-*): the Name/Description/Status/Color inputs and 'Save changes' are all enabled, and clicking Save fails with a 403 toast 'Requires manager or higher role'. Delete button is correctly hidden. Gate the link / make the form read-only when !canManage.

No fallback for an unknown status value — className becomes the literal string 'undefined' and the badge label is empty (reproduced with status='garbage'). Use a default entry, e.g. STATUS_STYLES[p.status] || STATUS_STYLES.active.

issues: Filter row looks good (icon + two selects + Clear); Clear only appears when a filter is set, as specified

sprint-filter-project lists every project including ones with zero sprints and 6 identically-named 'TEST_AutoLead' leftovers — dropdown is unreadable because of test-data pollution (data problem, not code)
Status badges (Active/On Hold/Planning/Archived) have good contrast and alignment; no issues

action_items: Validate project status on CREATE (POST /projects) the same way PATCH does — currently any string is accepted and breaks the badge + edit dialog rendering.
Add the missing Status Select (data-testid="project-create-status", default Active) to the create-project dialog in Projects.jsx and include status in the POST body.
Add a status fallback in Projects.jsx (STATUS_STYLES[p.status] || STATUS_STYLES.active) so unknown/legacy values don't render an empty badge with class 'undefined'.
Decide on manager scope for PATCH /projects: it currently bypasses require_project_access (manager can edit projects they cannot even see).
Make ProjectDialog read-only (or hide the sprint-card project link) for org members — they can currently open the edit form and only find out via a 403 toast.
Optional: have Sprints.jsx actually use the new ?project_id=&status= params instead of filtering client-side, otherwise the params are dead code.

Data hygiene: 7+ leftover TEST_* projects and an orphan task 'Bug fix test' (no project) clutter the workspace; one of them even caused a false burndown test failure (backend_test.py picks sprints[0]).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectCreate/ProjectUpdate should use typing.Literal for status so FastAPI/Pydantic enforces the enum in one place instead of a hand-rolled tuple check that only exists in update_project.

delete_project cascade is correct and ordered safely (collect task_ids before deleting tasks), but it is not transactional — a mid-way failure would leave orphans. Acceptable for now; consider a soft-delete flag or a session/transaction if data integrity matters.
backend_test.py::TestBurndown asserts on sprints[0] from a created_at-desc list — inherently flaky in a shared preview DB. Should pick the sprint named 'Sprint 1' of 'Web Redesign' explicitly.
server.py is now ~1300 lines; splitting routers (auth, orgs, projects, tasks, analytics) is overdue.
invite_member does not validate the role string either (same class of bug as project status) — any role value can be persisted into memberships.

rca_of_the_issue: create_project builds the document with `"status": body.status or "active"` and never runs the enum check that update_project performs, because the check was added only to the PATCH handler and ProjectCreate.status is a plain Optional[str]. Any client (or a stale/legacy document) can therefore store an arbitrary status; Projects.jsx then does STATUS_STYLES[p.status || 'active'] with no fallback, producing className '...rounded undefined' and an empty badge, and ProjectDialog's Select receives a value that is not in STATUS_OPTS so its trigger renders blank. Single-point fix: declare status as Literal['planning','active','on_hold','archived'] on both ProjectCreate and ProjectUpdate and add an `|| STATUS_STYLES.active` fallback in the UI.
